lines.text: Adonijah comes to Bathsheba and asks her to request Abishag the Shunammite as his wife.
Solomon seats his mother at his right hand, then has Benaiah strike down Adonijah for asking for Abishag.
Solomon sends Abiathar the priest back to his fields in Anathoth and banishes him from the priesthood, fulfilling the word against Saul's house.

wrong_details.true: the word against the house of Eli

lines.text: Joab flees to the tent of the LORD, but Benaiah kills him there, and Solomon puts Benaiah over the army.
Solomon forbids Shimei to cross the Jordan River, but after three years Shimei goes to Gath, and Benaiah strikes him down.
